title: VoiceAskResponse
description: Result of POST /voice/ask, returned once the engine decided and, for device actions, once every command was acknowledged or timed out.

reply_text.description: Answer to show to the user.

decision_id.description: Engine decision, null when the intent was unknown.

VoiceAskOutcome.title: VoiceAskOutcome
VoiceAskOutcome.description: executed means device commands were applied, answered means a query was answered, rejected means the engine could not carry it out, for example with the device offline, not_understood means the intent was unknown.

command.raw_text: what is the temperature in here

examples.reply_text: It is 23.4 degrees in the room.
